meta.title: Temporary Authenticated DSH Web
meta.description: Expose the running DeepSeek Harness Web GUI's authenticated URL to agents (gui_auth_url), and provide per-session temporary authenticated DSH Web instances: the /dsh-web command (start when absent, restart in place while keeping installed plugins) plus the dsh_web_start / dsh_web_restart tools — own process, throwaway DSH_HOME, own port, sessions never disturb each other.
